title: U.N. Live Updates: Iran’s President to Address World Leaders After Trump Threat
summary_full: Masoud Pezeshkian is the first leader whose country is at war with the United States to address the General Assembly in New York. On Tuesday, President Trump said he faced a choice over whether to “annihilate” the Islamic Republic.
